claims.summary: For fixed ell>=2,r>=1,A>0, 1<=M<=v^A and s=o(v/log(v)^(ell-2)), put D=floor(v/2-s), K=D-ceil(v^(1/3)), Delta0=r, eta(delta)=N_v(K-delta)/(2N_v(K)), t_j=ceil(log(2ell(M+1))/eta(Delta_(j-1))), Delta_j=Delta_(j-1)t_j. Then Delta_j=O(log(v)^j) for j<ell, t_ell and Delta_ell=v^o(1), summed ell-level error allowance is <1/2, and K+C Delta_ell<=D for each fixed C eventually.
claims.assessment: Working elementary asymptotic proof using a uniform lower-tail ratio bound exp(-32e delta(u+delta+2+sqrt(v))/v) for K=floor(v/2-u), u+delta=o(v). The size threshold may depend on the fixed exponent, depth and deficit sequence. No sharpness or old hard-family existence is asserted.
claims.rationale: Weakens the sufficient old-degree target from a square-root midpoint neighborhood to a depth-dependent moving gap by allowing a subpolynomial final layer. It leaves the actual lower-bound goal open and does not improve the underlying contraction mechanism.

claims.summary: In the moving-cutoff regime, a binary Boolean base Gamma with 1 notin C_D admits no degree-floor(v^(1/3)) PC refutation after adjoining at most v^A complete ENS blocks of fixed depth ell, uniform accuracy floor(v^epsilon), 0<epsilon<1/(3ell), whose inputs are degree<=r old polynomials plus constant combinations of actual block products from strictly lower levels, with distinct fresh Boolean coefficients and no other earlier-coefficient dependence.
claims.assessment: Working conditional-on-old-hardness source theorem. Acyclic constant choices contract each tuple rank on one common V_K/(C_D intersect V_K); a single final kernel supplies f notin C_D. Weighted PC replay uses K+B<=D. Original padded product and companion costs remain O(h^ell)=o(v^(1/3)); finite tuple length is unrestricted. No hard family or automatic Frege boundary is supplied.
claims.rationale: A complete source-level consequence of the numerical refinement, retaining coherent shared values and original degrees. Useful as a weaker sufficient old-PC target, not a Frege lower bound or evidence that an appropriate family exists.

relationships: The earlier obstruction assumes a fixed positive fractional midpoint gap; the moving little-o gap is outside that regime and does not contradict it.
The recursion supplies effective row counts, rank allowances and a reserve for the complete weighted PC replay.
Uses the proved per-group rank contraction with initial weight one, then sums the maps after all acyclic choices instead of selecting a new multiplier at each level.
